checks.description: Posted journals have at least two lines and balance independently.
checks.sql:
SELECT j.journal_id FROM journal j LEFT JOIN journal_line l USING(journal_id)
WHERE j.status='POSTED' GROUP BY j.journal_id
HAVING count(l.journal_line_id)<2 OR coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN direction='DEBIT' THEN amount ELSE -amount END),0)<>0
checks.coverage_limit: Does not verify that the chosen ledger accounts are economically correct.

checks.description: Mapped entries and ledger lines agree on direction and currency.
checks.sql:
SELECT p.posting_link_id FROM posting_link p JOIN account_entry e USING(account_entry_id)
JOIN account a ON a.account_id=e.account_id JOIN journal_line l USING(journal_line_id) JOIN journal j USING(journal_id)
WHERE p.allocated_amount<=0 OR e.direction<>l.direction OR a.currency_id<>j.currency_id OR j.status<>'POSTED'
checks.coverage_limit: Tests mapped pairs; does not prove that all source entries were supplied.

checks.description: Mapped entry allocations are complete and ledger lines are not overallocated.
checks.sql:
SELECT 'entry:'||e.account_entry_id AS item FROM account_entry e JOIN posting_link p USING(account_entry_id)
GROUP BY e.account_entry_id,e.amount HAVING sum(p.allocated_amount)<>e.amount
UNION ALL SELECT 'line:'||l.journal_line_id FROM journal_line l JOIN posting_link p USING(journal_line_id)
GROUP BY l.journal_line_id,l.amount HAVING sum(p.allocated_amount)>l.amount
checks.coverage_limit: Entries without any mapping are outside this check; separate source-completeness reconciliation is required.

checks.description: Statement closing balances reconcile to their listed entries.
checks.sql:
SELECT s.statement_id FROM statement s LEFT JOIN statement_line sl USING(statement_id)
LEFT JOIN account_entry e USING(account_entry_id) GROUP BY s.statement_id,s.opening_balance,s.closing_balance
HAVING s.closing_balance<>s.opening_balance+coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN e.direction='DEBIT' THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END),0)
checks.coverage_limit: Checks listed entries; C05 checks membership and account/date scope.

checks.description: Statement lines use the right account/date and every in-cycle entry is listed.
checks.sql:
SELECT 'line:'||sl.statement_line_id AS item FROM statement_line sl JOIN statement s USING(statement_id) JOIN account_entry e USING(account_entry_id)
WHERE e.account_id<>s.account_id OR e.posted_on<s.period_start OR e.posted_on>=s.period_end_exclusive
UNION ALL SELECT 'missing:'||s.statement_id||':'||e.account_entry_id FROM statement s JOIN account_entry e ON e.account_id=s.account_id AND e.posted_on>=s.period_start AND e.posted_on<s.period_end_exclusive
LEFT JOIN statement_line sl ON sl.statement_id=s.statement_id AND sl.account_entry_id=e.account_entry_id WHERE sl.statement_line_id IS NULL
checks.coverage_limit: Does not detect overlapping statement cycles or verify minimum-payment policy.

checks.description: Refund references are valid and cumulative refunds do not exceed purchases.
checks.sql:
SELECT t.card_transaction_id FROM card_transaction t LEFT JOIN card_transaction p ON t.original_transaction_id=p.card_transaction_id
WHERE (t.kind='PURCHASE' AND t.original_transaction_id IS NOT NULL)
OR (t.kind='REFUND' AND (p.card_transaction_id IS NULL OR p.kind<>'PURCHASE' OR p.card_id<>t.card_id OR p.merchant_id<>t.merchant_id OR p.currency_id<>t.currency_id OR t.posted_on<p.posted_on))
UNION ALL SELECT p.card_transaction_id FROM card_transaction p JOIN card_transaction r ON r.original_transaction_id=p.card_transaction_id AND r.kind='REFUND'
GROUP BY p.card_transaction_id,p.amount HAVING sum(r.amount)>p.amount
checks.coverage_limit: Network-specific refund exceptions and chargebacks are not modeled.

checks.description: Posted deposit orders have exactly the expected customer-account entries.
checks.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT payment_order_id,status FROM payment_event QUALIFY row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY payment_order_id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC)=1),
counts AS (SELECT o.payment_order_id,o.kind,o.amount,o.source_account_id,o.destination_account_id,o.beneficiary_id,o.currency_id,
count(e.account_entry_id) AS n,
count(e.account_entry_id) FILTER(WHERE e.account_id=o.source_account_id AND e.direction='DEBIT' AND e.amount=o.amount AND a.currency_id=o.currency_id) AS debits,
count(e.account_entry_id) FILTER(WHERE e.account_id=o.destination_account_id AND e.direction='CREDIT' AND e.amount=o.amount AND a.currency_id=o.currency_id) AS credits
FROM payment_order o JOIN latest s USING(payment_order_id) LEFT JOIN account_entry e ON e.payment_order_id=o.payment_order_id AND e.kind='DEPOSIT_PAYMENT'
LEFT JOIN account a ON a.account_id=e.account_id WHERE s.status IN ('POSTED','SETTLED','REVERSED','RETURNED','PARTIALLY_RETURNED') GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT payment_order_id FROM counts WHERE debits<>1 OR (kind='INTERNAL' AND (n<>2 OR credits<>1 OR destination_account_id IS NULL OR source_account_id=destination_account_id OR beneficiary_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (kind='OUTBOUND' AND (n<>1 OR beneficiary_id IS NULL OR destination_account_id IS NOT NULL))
checks.coverage_limit: Checks booked entry shape, including subsequently corrected payments. Does not validate product eligibility.

checks.description: Outbound settlement agrees with instructions and SETTLED status has evidence.
checks.sql:
SELECT s.payment_settlement_id AS item FROM payment_settlement s JOIN payment_order o USING(payment_order_id)
WHERE o.kind<>'OUTBOUND' OR s.settled_amount<>o.amount OR s.currency_id<>o.currency_id
UNION ALL SELECT o.payment_order_id FROM payment_order o JOIN (SELECT payment_order_id,status FROM payment_event QUALIFY row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY payment_order_id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC)=1) e USING(payment_order_id)
LEFT JOIN payment_settlement s USING(payment_order_id) WHERE e.status IN ('SETTLED','RETURNED','PARTIALLY_RETURNED') AND (s.payment_settlement_id IS NULL OR o.kind<>'OUTBOUND')
checks.coverage_limit: Original outbound settlement is full; returns can arrive in installments. Rail calendars and fees remain excluded.

checks.description: Scheduled principal totals each contracted loan principal.
checks.sql:
SELECT c.loan_contract_id FROM loan_contract c LEFT JOIN loan_schedule_item s USING(loan_contract_id)
GROUP BY c.loan_contract_id,c.principal_amount HAVING coalesce(sum(s.principal_due),0)<>c.principal_amount
checks.coverage_limit: Does not generate interest or check all schedule dates.

checks.description: Loan funding has one matching loan debit and deposit credit.
checks.sql:
SELECT d.loan_disbursement_id FROM loan_disbursement d JOIN loan_contract c USING(loan_contract_id)
LEFT JOIN account_entry e ON e.loan_disbursement_id=d.loan_disbursement_id AND e.kind='LOAN_DRAW'
GROUP BY d.loan_disbursement_id,d.amount,d.destination_account_id,d.disbursed_on,c.account_id,c.principal_amount,c.accepted_on
HAVING d.amount<>c.principal_amount OR d.disbursed_on<c.accepted_on OR count(e.account_entry_id)<>2
OR count(e.account_entry_id) FILTER(WHERE e.account_id=c.account_id AND e.direction='DEBIT' AND e.amount=d.amount)<>1
OR count(e.account_entry_id) FILTER(WHERE e.account_id=d.destination_account_id AND e.direction='CREDIT' AND e.amount=d.amount)<>1
checks.coverage_limit: Does not verify borrower eligibility or the destination product kind.

checks.description: Posted loan repayments create only their principal reduction on the loan account.
checks.sql:
SELECT r.loan_repayment_id FROM loan_repayment r JOIN loan_contract c USING(loan_contract_id)
LEFT JOIN account_entry e ON e.loan_repayment_id=r.loan_repayment_id AND e.kind='LOAN_REPAYMENT'
WHERE r.status='POSTED' GROUP BY r.loan_repayment_id,r.principal_amount,r.interest_amount,c.account_id
HAVING r.principal_amount<0 OR r.interest_amount<0 OR r.principal_amount+r.interest_amount<=0
OR count(e.account_entry_id)<>CASE WHEN r.principal_amount>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
OR count(e.account_entry_id) FILTER(WHERE e.account_id=c.account_id AND e.direction='CREDIT' AND e.amount=r.principal_amount)<>CASE WHEN r.principal_amount>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
checks.coverage_limit: Does not validate installment allocation, principal overpayment or interest-ledger completeness.

checks.description: Every account entry uses exactly its permitted source reference.
checks.sql:
SELECT account_entry_id FROM account_entry WHERE
 (CASE WHEN card_transaction_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN payment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN fee_type_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN reverses_entry_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN payment_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN loan_disbursement_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN loan_repayment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN payment_return_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <> CASE WHEN kind='ADJUSTMENT' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
 OR (kind='CARD' AND card_transaction_id IS NULL) OR (kind='PAYMENT' AND payment_id IS NULL) OR (kind='FEE' AND fee_type_id IS NULL) OR (kind='REVERSAL' AND reverses_entry_id IS NULL) OR (kind='DEPOSIT_PAYMENT' AND payment_order_id IS NULL) OR (kind='LOAN_DRAW' AND loan_disbursement_id IS NULL) OR (kind='LOAN_REPAYMENT' AND loan_repayment_id IS NULL) OR (kind='PAYMENT_RETURN' AND payment_return_id IS NULL)
checks.coverage_limit: Source linkage alone does not validate the source amount or lifecycle.

checks.description: Posted transaction and journal amounts are strictly positive.
checks.sql:
SELECT 'entry:'||account_entry_id AS item FROM account_entry WHERE amount<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'card:'||card_transaction_id FROM card_transaction WHERE amount<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'line:'||journal_line_id FROM journal_line WHERE amount<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'order:'||payment_order_id FROM payment_order WHERE amount<=0
checks.coverage_limit: Applies to these four tables only; signed balances and nonnegative schedule amounts follow separate conventions.

checks.description: Reversals preserve the original and negate its exact account movement.
checks.sql:
SELECT r.account_entry_id FROM account_entry r LEFT JOIN account_entry o ON o.account_entry_id=r.reverses_entry_id WHERE r.kind='REVERSAL' AND (o.account_entry_id IS NULL OR o.kind='REVERSAL' OR o.account_id<>r.account_id OR o.amount<>r.amount OR o.direction=r.direction OR r.posted_on<o.posted_on)
UNION ALL SELECT reverses_entry_id FROM account_entry WHERE kind='REVERSAL' GROUP BY reverses_entry_id HAVING count(*)<>1
checks.coverage_limit: Full reversals only; persistence-level immutability is not enforced by this analytical database.

checks.description: Full internal reversals have one opposite entry per original; outbound returns use installments.
checks.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT payment_order_id,status FROM payment_event QUALIFY row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY payment_order_id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC)=1)
SELECT o.payment_order_id FROM payment_order o JOIN latest s USING(payment_order_id) WHERE (s.status='REVERSED' AND o.kind<>'INTERNAL') OR (s.status='RETURNED' AND o.kind<>'OUTBOUND')
UNION ALL SELECT e.account_entry_id FROM account_entry e JOIN latest s USING(payment_order_id) LEFT JOIN account_entry r ON r.reverses_entry_id=e.account_entry_id WHERE e.kind='DEPOSIT_PAYMENT' GROUP BY e.account_entry_id,s.status HAVING count(r.account_entry_id)<>CASE WHEN s.status IN ('REVERSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
checks.coverage_limit: C20-C22 validate outbound installments separately. Reversal-of-reversal remains unsupported.

checks.description: payment_event history follows its explicit transition matrix.
checks.sql: WITH history AS (SELECT *,lag(status) OVER(PARTITION BY payment_order_id ORDER BY occurred_at) previous FROM payment_event) SELECT payment_event_id FROM history WHERE (previous IS NULL AND status<>'RECEIVED') OR (previous IS NOT NULL AND NOT ((previous='RECEIVED' AND status IN ('VALIDATED','FAILED','CANCELLED')) OR (previous='VALIDATED' AND status IN ('POSTED','FAILED','CANCELLED')) OR (previous='POSTED' AND status IN ('SETTLED','REVERSED')) OR (previous='SETTLED' AND status IN ('PARTIALLY_RETURNED','RETURNED')) OR (previous='PARTIALLY_RETURNED' AND status IN ('PARTIALLY_RETURNED','RETURNED'))))
checks.coverage_limit: Requires complete effective-time histories. Corrections, late arrivals and same-time sequencing are not supported.

checks.description: account_status_event history follows its explicit transition matrix.
checks.sql: WITH history AS (SELECT *,lag(status) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY effective_at) previous FROM account_status_event) SELECT account_status_event_id FROM history WHERE (previous IS NULL AND status<>'OPEN') OR (previous IS NOT NULL AND NOT ((previous='OPEN' AND status IN ('RESTRICTED','CLOSED')) OR (previous='RESTRICTED' AND status IN ('OPEN','CLOSED'))))
checks.coverage_limit: Requires complete effective-time histories. Corrections, late arrivals and same-time sequencing are not supported.

checks.description: card_status_event history follows its explicit transition matrix.
checks.sql: WITH history AS (SELECT *,lag(status) OVER(PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY effective_at) previous FROM card_status_event) SELECT card_status_event_id FROM history WHERE (previous IS NULL AND status<>'ISSUED') OR (previous IS NOT NULL AND NOT ((previous='ISSUED' AND status IN ('ACTIVE','CLOSED')) OR (previous='ACTIVE' AND status IN ('BLOCKED','EXPIRED','CLOSED')) OR (previous='BLOCKED' AND status IN ('ACTIVE','EXPIRED','CLOSED')) OR (previous='EXPIRED' AND status IN ('CLOSED'))))
checks.coverage_limit: Requires complete effective-time histories. Corrections, late arrivals and same-time sequencing are not supported.

checks.description: Every account and entry has complete, correctly targeted ledger mappings.
checks.sql:
SELECT a.account_id AS item FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_gl_mapping m USING(account_id) WHERE m.account_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT e.account_entry_id FROM account_entry e LEFT JOIN posting_link p USING(account_entry_id) GROUP BY e.account_entry_id,e.amount HAVING coalesce(sum(p.allocated_amount),0)<>e.amount
UNION ALL SELECT p.posting_link_id FROM posting_link p JOIN account_entry e USING(account_entry_id) JOIN account_gl_mapping m USING(account_id) JOIN journal_line l USING(journal_line_id) WHERE l.gl_account_id<>m.gl_account_id
checks.coverage_limit: Completeness is relative to supplied source rows, not an external bank feed.

checks.description: Return installments follow settlement, are positive and never exceed the order amount.
checks.sql:
SELECT r.payment_return_id FROM payment_return r JOIN payment_order o USING(payment_order_id) LEFT JOIN payment_settlement s USING(payment_order_id) WHERE o.kind<>'OUTBOUND' OR r.amount<=0 OR s.payment_settlement_id IS NULL OR r.returned_on<s.settled_on
UNION ALL SELECT r.payment_order_id FROM payment_return r JOIN payment_order o USING(payment_order_id) GROUP BY r.payment_order_id,o.amount HAVING sum(r.amount)>o.amount
checks.coverage_limit: Single-currency full original settlement, with no return fees or FX.

checks.description: Each installment has exactly one equal customer credit on the source account and matching booking date.
checks.sql: SELECT r.payment_return_id FROM payment_return r JOIN payment_order o USING(payment_order_id) LEFT JOIN account_entry e ON e.payment_return_id=r.payment_return_id GROUP BY r.payment_return_id,r.amount,r.returned_on,o.source_account_id HAVING count(e.account_entry_id)<>1 OR count(e.account_entry_id) FILTER(WHERE e.kind='PAYMENT_RETURN' AND e.direction='CREDIT' AND e.amount=r.amount AND e.account_id=o.source_account_id AND e.posted_on=r.returned_on)<>1
checks.coverage_limit: Ledger mapping and balances are checked separately; does not prove receipt from a real network.

checks.description: Return status agrees with cumulative returned funds as of every return-state event and latest state.
checks.sql:
WITH cumulative AS (SELECT e.payment_event_id,e.status,o.amount,coalesce(sum(r.amount),0) total FROM payment_event e JOIN payment_order o USING(payment_order_id) LEFT JOIN payment_return r ON r.payment_order_id=o.payment_order_id AND r.returned_on<=CAST(e.occurred_at AS DATE) WHERE e.status IN ('PARTIALLY_RETURNED','RETURNED') GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT payment_event_id FROM cumulative WHERE (status='RETURNED' AND total<>amount) OR (status='PARTIALLY_RETURNED' AND (total<=0 OR total>=amount))
UNION ALL SELECT o.payment_order_id FROM payment_order o JOIN (SELECT payment_order_id,status FROM payment_event QUALIFY row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY payment_order_id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC)=1) e USING(payment_order_id) JOIN payment_return r USING(payment_order_id) WHERE e.status NOT IN ('PARTIALLY_RETURNED','RETURNED')
UNION ALL SELECT o.payment_order_id FROM payment_order o JOIN (SELECT payment_order_id,status FROM payment_event QUALIFY row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY payment_order_id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC)=1) e USING(payment_order_id) JOIN payment_return r USING(payment_order_id) GROUP BY o.payment_order_id,o.amount,e.status HAVING (e.status='PARTIALLY_RETURNED' AND sum(r.amount)>=o.amount) OR (e.status='RETURNED' AND sum(r.amount)<>o.amount)
checks.coverage_limit: Return observations use business dates; intraday ordering of same-day installments is not modeled.

checks.description: Fraud case links have a matching card user or account holder, and decisions follow case opening.
checks.sql:
SELECT x.fraud_case_alert_id FROM fraud_case_alert x JOIN fraud_case f USING(fraud_case_id) JOIN fraud_alert a USING(fraud_alert_id) JOIN card_transaction t USING(card_transaction_id) JOIN card c USING(card_id) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM card_assignment ca WHERE ca.card_id=c.card_id AND ca.customer_id=f.customer_id AND ca.valid_from<=t.posted_on AND (ca.valid_to IS NULL OR ca.valid_to>t.posted_on)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_holder h WHERE h.account_id=c.account_id AND h.customer_id=f.customer_id AND h.valid_from<=t.posted_on AND (h.valid_to IS NULL OR h.valid_to>t.posted_on))
UNION ALL SELECT d.fraud_decision_id FROM fraud_decision d JOIN fraud_case f USING(fraud_case_id) WHERE d.decided_at<f.opened_at
checks.coverage_limit: Does not perform fraud detection, validate action execution or confirm the assessment is correct.

checks.description: Collections values, promise dates, support intervals and account relationships are structurally coherent.
checks.sql:
SELECT delinquency_snapshot_id FROM delinquency_snapshot WHERE days_past_due<0 OR overdue_amount<0
UNION ALL SELECT promise_to_pay_id FROM promise_to_pay WHERE promised_amount<=0 OR due_on<promised_on
UNION ALL SELECT hardship_plan_id FROM hardship_plan WHERE ends_on<=starts_on
UNION ALL SELECT c.collection_case_id FROM collection_case c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_holder h WHERE h.customer_id=c.customer_id AND h.account_id=c.account_id AND h.valid_from<=c.opened_on AND (h.valid_to IS NULL OR h.valid_to>c.opened_on))
checks.coverage_limit: Days past due and overdue amount are supplied, not calculated. Promise fulfillment and legal eligibility are not implemented.

checks.description: Points snapshots reconcile independently aggregated earnings, fulfilled redemptions and adjustments.
checks.sql: SELECT b.reward_balance_snapshot_id FROM reward_balance_snapshot b WHERE b.points_balance<>coalesce((SELECT sum(e.points) FROM reward_earn e WHERE e.reward_membership_id=b.reward_membership_id AND e.earned_on<=b.as_of_date),0)-coalesce((SELECT sum(r.points) FROM reward_redemption r WHERE r.reward_membership_id=b.reward_membership_id AND r.status='FULFILLED' AND CAST(r.requested_at AS DATE)<=b.as_of_date),0)+coalesce((SELECT sum(a.points_delta) FROM reward_adjustment a WHERE a.reward_membership_id=b.reward_membership_id AND a.adjusted_on<=b.as_of_date),0)
checks.coverage_limit: Assumes zero points at enrollment and complete lifetime records. Fulfillment timing is simplified to request date for fulfilled rows.

checks.description: Reward awards use the membership account and valid positive purchase units; corrections stay in membership.
checks.sql:
SELECT e.reward_earn_id FROM reward_earn e JOIN reward_membership m USING(reward_membership_id) JOIN card_transaction t USING(card_transaction_id) JOIN card c USING(card_id) WHERE e.points<=0 OR t.kind<>'PURCHASE' OR c.account_id<>m.account_id OR e.earned_on<m.enrolled_on OR e.earned_on<t.posted_on
UNION ALL SELECT reward_redemption_id FROM reward_redemption WHERE points<=0
UNION ALL SELECT a.reward_adjustment_id FROM reward_adjustment a LEFT JOIN reward_earn e USING(reward_earn_id) WHERE a.points_delta=0 OR (a.reward_earn_id IS NOT NULL AND a.reward_membership_id<>e.reward_membership_id)
checks.coverage_limit: Earning rates, redemption availability and refund clawback policies are supplied, not calculated.

checks.description: Service and complaint events respect intake dates and customer-account relationships.
checks.sql:
SELECT e.service_request_event_id FROM service_request_event e JOIN service_request s USING(service_request_id) WHERE e.occurred_at<s.opened_at
UNION ALL SELECT c.complaint_id FROM complaint c JOIN service_request s USING(service_request_id) WHERE c.received_on<CAST(s.opened_at AS DATE)
UNION ALL SELECT r.complaint_resolution_id FROM complaint_resolution r JOIN complaint c USING(complaint_id) WHERE r.resolved_on<c.received_on
UNION ALL SELECT s.service_request_id FROM service_request s WHERE s.account_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_holder h WHERE h.account_id=s.account_id AND h.customer_id=s.customer_id AND h.valid_from<=CAST(s.opened_at AS DATE) AND (h.valid_to IS NULL OR h.valid_to>CAST(s.opened_at AS DATE)))
checks.coverage_limit: No regulatory deadlines, delivery confirmation verification or full service workflow transition engine.
